description: Free tier: 25 calls/day per IP with header X-Free-Call: 1 (or ?free=1), then pay per call. Rule-based prompt-injection screen for untrusted text such as scraped web pages, emails and tool output. JSON body {text} (max 50,000 chars). Detects instruction-override phrasing, role-spoofing tags, data-leak links and hidden Unicode in 6 languages. Returns verdict safe, suspicious or malicious, a 0-100 score and matched spans. Text is not stored. Price $0.005 USDC per call via x402. Example output: {"verdict":"safe","score":0,"chars":56,"categories":{},"matches":[]}
name: prompt_injection_check
